author: Mike Kasberg
units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

decisions.adaptation: Two upright end keys carry four4.4×1.6mm tongues. Total socket allowance.10 reproduces measured interface; default.15 and range.10–.35 are proposed. Socket width=sheet+allowance; length=tongue+allowance.

decisions.measured: Carrier planes.21/.22mm and separately cut sheet pieces
decisions.adaptation: Nine original parts packed in a two-column carrier and Boolean-connected by32 bed-aligned .4–.6mm runners. Keys have two broad-shoulder runners each; other parts have four. Runner thickness deliberately thicker than source.

decisions.original: Five closed-slot blades and a dual-rail capture assembly
decisions.adaptation: Original contour sampling mechanism, not source spacecraft geometry. Integral1.6×3mm pins, slot length3+travel, width1.6+2*runningGap. RunningGap.20–.35 PER SIDE is proposed, independent of fixed joint allowance.

decisions.original: Lower rail2.4–3.2mm and upper rail1.6–2mm separated by blade thickness+two running gaps
decisions.adaptation: Upper rail prevents lift; closed slots stop travel. Pin remains engaged by sheet-.1mm at max lift. Four fixed end-key seats require adhesive. No clamping, self-locking or precision claim.
Image20×20 heightfield or exact accepted convex STL subtracts.4–.6mm; >=1mm upper-rail backing. Concave/hollow/open/overhung STL rejected, never replaced by a hull.
